bug_locations: while q[user] and q[user][0] < t-window: (boundary condition)
explanation: Two bugs: (1) The window boundary was wrong — the spec defines the interval as (time-window, time], open on the left, so events at exactly t-window should be excluded. The fix changes `< t-window` to `<= t-window` so timestamps equal to t-window are removed. (2) Rejected events were being appended to the queue, consuming capacity. The spec says rejected events do not consume capacity, so the append is now conditional on `ok` being True.
